about_the_game:
With our Easy Gacha System plugin, you’ll be able to enhance your game experience by adding a complete prize-drawing system! Players can spend in-game or premium currency to roll for random rewards, including items, equipment, or even characters. You can configure banners, drop rates, rarity tiers, guaranteed prizes, and much more, your imagination is the only limit!

Key Features:

●     Customizable Gacha Banners: Define your own banners with item pools, rarity tiers, and drop rates.

●     Multi-Currency Support: Use RPG Maker’s default currency or define your own custom ones to spend on gacha rolls.

●     Guaranteed Rewards: Set up fixed rewards after a certain number of pulls.

●     Reward History Scene: Keep a record of all previous rewards obtained.

●     Fragment System: Unlock characters by collecting fragments from the gacha.

●     Flexible UI Options: Customize fonts, colors, animations, and layout from the plugin parameters.

●     And much more!

What's in this package?Attached is a compressed ZIP file containing:

  - The Easy Gacha System plugin file: "Ultimate_Gacha_Minigame.js":
Including all versions released to date.
(May include "Release" and "Alternative" versions)

- The "Plugin Support" folder contains an HTML file that, when run, will display more information about the plugin. (Plugin demonstration video, support links*, among other things)
* Important: Support is only available in English and Spanish.

- The plugin documentation is included within the plugin itself; you can read it through the RPG MAKER MZ Plugin Editor

If you have questions about other topics, please visit our support page for more information.

-------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
